subject: music
title: Expression & Articulation
welcome_lead: Staccato dots and accent marks change how notes feel.
meta_desc: KS3 dynamics: articulation, accents, expression marks.
final_note: Same notes, different articulation — different feel.

concepts.def: How a note is attacked and shaped.
A note played with extra force.

walkthroughs.body_html: A dot above or below a note means staccato — play it short and detached. Each note is cut off quickly.
A curved slur over notes means legato — play smoothly with no gaps between them. On wind instruments, you play them in one breath.
A > above a note is an accent — play with extra force. Sforzando (sfz) is an even stronger sudden accent. Use to surprise the listener.
